display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
us-east-1 goes down → promote eu-west-1 to primary
→ all writes go to eu-west-1
→ us-east-1 comes back → re-sync from eu-west-1
→ some writes may be lost (1-2s window)

Writes go to primary (80ms RTT latency)
